Episode inventory and writing credits do not establish every language mix, supplied master or frame-level version. Public references are not open media licences.
Dates remain scoped to cinema, television and streaming. No physical-media, purchase-download or classification dates are added in this supplement.

All six final episode writing credits are covered, with Story by, Teleplay by and Written by kept separate. This is not the complete end-credit roll. May 26 Pacific and May 27 Eastern describe the same original launch.
The documentary A Jedi’s Return and unofficial fan-made film edits are separate from this six-part limited series.

No officially documented alternate cut was identified in the earlier scoped release search; absence of documentation does not prove that no variation exists. Worldwide and Finnish release histories remain incomplete.
